rows.description: kodbox is a file manager for web. It is a newly designed product based on kodexplorer. It is also a web code editor, which allows you to develop websites directly within the web browser.You can run kodbox either online or locally,on Linux, Windows or Mac based platforms
Preview 275+ file formats in the browser: Office, PDF, OFD, CAD, 3D, archives. Pure frontend, no server conversion. Vue / React / Svelte / Web Components.
Take a gander at any file. Offline, zero-permission Android viewer for PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODT, RTF, ZIP, STL, photos, video, audio, Markdown and code.
